widgets.name: Component Slot
widgets.description: Marks where content the caller supplies is rendered. Put one in a reusable component and instances of it gain a named slot — in the widget tree, and in the properties panel when a "Widget slot" property names it.

widgets.name: Image Container
widgets.description: Places children at absolute spots over a background image. Collapses below a set width.

widgets.name: Container
widgets.description: Groups and lays out child widgets in a row or column. Hosts other widgets.

widgets.name: Fixed Spacer
widgets.description: A precise pixel gap between widgets.

widgets.name: Separator
widgets.description: A thin divider line between widgets.

widgets.name: Stretch Spacer
widgets.description: Flexible gap that pushes neighbours apart, by ratio or percent.

widgets.name: Alarm History
widgets.description: The rolling log of past alarm events.

widgets.name: Alarm List
widgets.description: Live active alarms, filterable by level, with acknowledgement.

widgets.name: Button
widgets.description: Runs actions and can bind a writable boolean struct (bVisible / bEnabled / bValue).

widgets.name: Clock
widgets.description: A live clock, formatted with the same patterns as the $time source.

widgets.name: Icon
widgets.description: A themeable Phosphor icon at any size and colour.

widgets.name: Image
widgets.description: Shows an asset with a fit mode and optional data-driven indicators.

widgets.name: Label
widgets.description: Text in one of the theme typography combos, with translation support.

widgets.name: Logo Title
widgets.description: A logo image paired with a title and an optional subtitle.

widgets.name: Page Title
widgets.description: The current page's title and icon, or your own override text.

widgets.name: Status Pill
widgets.description: A tone-colored status pill, with an optional second line and pulsing dot.

widgets.name: Trend Chart
widgets.description: Plots recorded tag history over selectable time ranges, or buffers live values with no historian.

widgets.name: User Badge
widgets.description: Shows the currently signed-in user as an initialled badge.

widgets.name: Web Frame
widgets.description: Embeds an external web page in an iframe.

widgets.name: Button Row
widgets.description: A row of mutually-exclusive buttons — pick 1 of N. Writes the chosen option to a bound variable, or tracks selection locally and fires On Change.

widgets.name: Dropdown
widgets.description: Pick one option from a list. Publishes the selection for sibling widgets to read and fires On Change.

widgets.name: Number Input
widgets.description: A numeric entry field that writes a number to a variable.

widgets.name: Numeric Stepper
widgets.description: Increment / decrement a numeric variable with + / − buttons.

widgets.name: String Input
widgets.description: A text field whose typed value is published for sibling widgets to read.

widgets.name: Switch
widgets.description: A toggle that writes a boolean on/off to a variable.

widgets.name: Gauge
widgets.description: A round analog gauge with min/max and a value binding.

widgets.name: LED Indicator
widgets.description: A status light that changes colour with a boolean.

widgets.name: Progress Bar
widgets.description: A horizontal bar showing a percentage or progress value.

widgets.name: Ring Gauge
widgets.description: A donut ring showing a value as a share of its range, with the reading in the hole.

widgets.name: Stat Tile
widgets.description: KPI tile: label, value and unit, with a tinted icon in row mode.

widgets.name: Trend
widgets.description: A live sparkline of one variable with its current reading — buffered in the page, no historian.

widgets.name: Value Display
widgets.description: Displays a numeric value with a label and unit.

widgets.name: Navigation Menu
widgets.description: Sidebar or top-bar menu mirroring the page tree, with rich display options.

widgets.name: Breadcrumb
widgets.description: The trail of pages to where you are, with optional home icon.

widgets.name: Language Switcher
widgets.description: Lets operators change the interface language.

widgets.name: Menu Toggle
widgets.description: Collapses or expands a bound menu state; swaps icon per state.

widgets.name: Page Navigator
widgets.description: Previous / next controls stepping through a page group.

widgets.name: Tab Bar
widgets.description: Switches between the sibling pages of a group as tabs.
